SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate,
T6.TYPE_9 assetType1, T6.TYPE_10 assetType10, T6.TYPE_11 assetType11,
T6.TYPE_7 assetType2, T1.CCY ccy, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
union all SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate,
T6.TYPE_9 assetType1, T6.TYPE_10 assetType10, T6.TYPE_11 assetType11,
T6.TYPE_7 assetType2, T1.CCY ccy, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

select NVL(C.VALUATION,0) value from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO A, FIN_PRODUCT B, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION C WHERE C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND B.MANAGER = A.CUSTOMER_ID(+) AND B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} AND C.VAL_DATE =to_date(#{sysdate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
